claims: Maintain continuous invasive hemodynamic and ECG monitoring with ST-segment surveillance given hypotension, norepinephrine infusion, and troponin elevation.
Continue norepinephrine infusion and titrate to maintain mean arterial pressure above 65 mmHg.
Recheck arterial blood gas and lactate within 24 hours to assess oxygenation, acid-base status, and perfusion.
Recheck INR/PT and PTT within 24 hours given supratherapeutic INR and recent phytonadione administration.
Recheck serum creatinine and electrolytes within 24 hours to monitor acute kidney injury and hyperphosphatemia.
Continue BiPap support with current settings and monitor respiratory status and oxygen saturation.
Continue telemetry and continuous pulse oximetry monitoring with alarms enabled.
Perform delirium assessment (CAM-ICU) and orient the patient as clinically appropriate.
Monitor blood glucose and continue insulin therapy per sliding scale.
Maintain PICC line patency with heparin flushes and monitor for line complications.
